text: many car alarms going off at once on a jammed highway after a blast, distant echoes, wailing sirens of cars
small delivery motorcycle approaching fast between cars, revving, then braking to a stop
heavy rain pouring down concrete subway stairs, water streaming and splashing, echoing underground
portable radio tuning static crackle then a clear signal locks in
enormous distant nuclear blast shockwave, deep rumble and glass windows shattering, rolling thunder
